rules.name: continuous_cross_domain_scan
rules.summary: Relevant domain/Z-stack agents cross-reference new evidence automatically; synthesis remains evidence-labelled.

rules.name: known_unknown_registration
rules.summary: Unresolved required variables receive stable IDs, dependencies, resolution methods and falsifiable next steps; closure requires evidence or a supersession receipt.

rules.name: autonomous_research_proposal
rules.summary: New patterns/unknowns generate agent-reviewed research proposals with completed/current-task comparison, expected information gain and preliminary H/M/L priority; proposals are not validation.

rules.name: information_yield_first
rules.summary: Prefer material knowledge/operational improvement and dependency unlock over micro-refinement, subject to safety/acceptance exceptions; low-yield tasks remain indexed.

rules.name: raw_test_preservation
rules.summary: Write immutable/raw test record before synthesis; preserve original inputs, code/config, environment, outputs, errors, timestamps and receipts where available; corrections append and never silently replace source evidence.

rules.name: outcome_classification
rules.summary: Classify analysis-stage results as VALID_POSITIVE, VALID_NULL, VALID_NEGATIVE, OUTLIER, INCONCLUSIVE, INVALID_HARNESS, INVALID_INPUT, MODEL_LIMITATION or SUPERSEDED; physical null/negative results must remain distinct from code/test failure.

rules.name: sweep_synthesis
rules.summary: Completed bounded sweeps produce hypothesis/null/expectation/observed/outlier/limits/reasoning/next-step synthesis referencing all underlying test IDs; statistical method must match the data and assumptions and must not force normal/bell-curve treatment where inappropriate.

rules.name: technology_centric_twin
rules.summary: One canonical twin/workbook per technology family; configurations/tests are versioned rows/receipts and may carry asset/test IDs without creating parallel masters; separate masters require a materially different technology/authority boundary.

rules.name: cross_domain_equation_abstraction
rules.summary: Candidate common equations require explicit variable/unit/domain/invariant/failure-condition mappings and falsifiable predictions; analogy alone is insufficient and originating discipline equations/mappings remain preserved.

rules.name: evidence_triggered_reanalysis
rules.summary: Material new evidence automatically identifies downstream conclusions/tasks for reanalysis while retaining prior conclusions and supersession lineage; stale values must not propagate silently.

rules.name: research_engineering_boundary
rules.summary: Novel R&D layers remain separate from certified/conventional baseline and cannot bypass physical, professional or regulatory validation; safety/compliance gates outrank novelty and information gain.

rules.name: partner_proposal_firewall
rules.summary: Named external organisations remain PROPOSED / EARMARKED / CANDIDATE until attributable agreements or authority evidence exist; planning shorthand must not become a public claim.

priority_feature_provenance: CPR-003/004 plus owner-current OD-021/OD-022; distance_from_established_knowns is owner-current doctrine from OD-021.
owner_control: Owner may override task priority, depth and order and may challenge classifications/syntheses; provenance, raw evidence and prior states remain immutable/append-only rather than silently overwritten.
evidence_invariants: Inference never becomes fact without evidence/validation.
Known-unknown closure points to a source, test, calculation or supersession receipt.
Raw records remain distinct from interpretation and synthesis.
Invalid harness/input/model limitation is not a physical null or concept falsification.
Statistical treatment must match data and assumptions.
Cross-domain analogy requires falsifiable predictions before promotion.
New evidence triggers material downstream reanalysis without erasing superseded conclusions.
R&D performance remains separate from certified conventional baseline and professional/regulatory acceptance.
External partner participation is not current fact without attributable authority evidence.
no_go: Do not promote agent inference to fact without evidence.
Do not classify code/test-harness failure as physical null.
Do not delete negative, null, outlier, failed or superseded results.
Do not force normal/bell-curve analysis where inappropriate.
Do not let novelty override safety/compliance gates.
Do not silently propagate stale values.
Do not present proposed partners as committed participants without evidence.
